name: range-v3
listed_description: Eric Niebler's range library, basis of C++20 std::ranges; the book shows it doing lazy transform and zip_with views as an alternative to hand-written expression templates.
claim_text: Lazy views replace expression templates; construct, copy and destroy time does not depend on the underlying range size. No numbers.
guessed_baseline: eager std::vector algorithms with temporary containers (std::transform plus std::vector temporaries)
found_in: book: Template Metaprogramming with C++ (2022), ch. 7 Patterns and Idioms, section Using ranges as an alternative to expression templates

name: Expression templates (lazy vector arithmetic)
listed_description: Book builds a vector class whose operators return lazy expression objects, evaluated element by element on assignment, so chained additions and scalar multiplications create no temporary vectors.
claim_text: Expression templates avoid temporaries and so help performance when objects are large; cost is more code and longer compile times. No timings.
guessed_baseline: eager operator overloading with a temporary vector per operation
found_in: book: Template Metaprogramming with C++ (2022), ch. 7 Patterns and Idioms, section Expression templates
